key_insight: The paper extends FE2 homogenization to shear-deformable beam structures by coupling a beam-scale model with a truss-scale lattice RVE, enabling efficient multiscale analysis of periodic lattice-like members.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical modeling route for additive-manufactured load-bearing lattice beams, capturing microstructure effects without fully resolving the entire lattice in the global analysis.
method: Beam-based FE2 framework for 3D shear-deformable macroscopic members
Truss-based microscopic RVE with periodic displacement boundary conditions
Constraint equations plus local correction factors to remove rigid-body modes and boundary artifacts
evidence_signal: Numerical studies on 2D and 3D lattice-like structures, including linear and nonlinear cases, show RVE-length-independent homogenized stress resultants/material matrices and good agreement with reference models.
watch_item: The approach relies on carefully designed periodic RVEs and correction factors, so implementation may be sensitive to boundary treatment and microstructure periodicity assumptions.
paper_title: An FE2 model for shear-deformable beams considering periodic lattice-like truss mesostructures
